text:
Nia Roberts: Partner wants a tiny CI+secrets playbook for marketplace onboarding. They need patterns for: repo secrets, OIDC ephemeral creds, signed artifacts, and a safe smoke deploy that doesnt leak S3 keys. Can we sketch a short checklist + minimal examples?
DevOps Sam: short checklist: 1) Use GH OIDC -> STS role for ephemeral creds; 2) No long-lived secrets in runners; 3) Use cosign for image sigs, syft for SBOM; 4) Presigned URLs or small artifact gateway for model pulls.
Arun Patel: sample GH Action snippet for OIDC assume-role:
```yaml
permissions: id-token: write
jobs:
  assume:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: request token
        run: echo "REQUESTING ID TOKEN"
```
Arun Patel: Terraform should create a narrowly scoped role (PutObject to prefix, SSM GetParameter for endpoint) and trust bound to repo/org. Avoid broad s3:* policies.
Priya Kapoor: add guidance for private-only deployments: mirror artifacts to partner internal repo or proxy presign requests. Also include rotation guidance (90d) and a short remediation playbook if a compromised token is detected.
Marketplace Bot: attached: https://git.internal/redwood/partnerships/marketplace-cookbook/ci-secrets-playbook.md
Nia Roberts: action owners: Arun -> Terraform + action snippets, Sam -> smoke script (curl based) and cosign example, Priya -> partner-facing wording and compliance notes. Aim: branch partnerships/marketplace-ci-mini/1748123456, review by EOW.
